title: Knowledge Package Layout
description: Canonical containment hierarchy: Module → Pack → Section → Knowledge Record. Specification only.

hierarchy.description: Top-level knowledge domain folder under a discipline tree (e.g. knowledge/bazi/).
Design and publication bundle of related Knowledge Records.
Logical grouping within a Pack for docs and navigation.
Publication event bound to Pack and/or Module via release fields.
SemVer for Pack, Module, and Knowledge Record artifacts.
Declared version ranges and breaking-change notes between packs/modules/canon.

rules.statement: Every Pack MUST belong to exactly one Module.
Every Knowledge Record in a Pack MUST appear in pack.record_ids.
Sections SHOULD partition record_ids without overlap unless cross-listed with notes.
Version fields MUST use SemVer MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.
Compatibility.breaking_changes MUST be non-empty when MAJOR version increments for a released Pack.
